question: Does the independent BANC v888 connectome show the same right-front vs left-front SNpp45 hair-plate deficit (neuron count and neuron size) that MaleCNS shows and that blocks joint_RFCoxa?
feasibility_inspection_before_registrati: Whole-table BANC vocabularies only: neuromere, side, proofread, super_class value counts and the distinct nerve names; the total number of rows with cell_type SNpp45 (166) was printed incidentally, with no per-leg, per-side or size breakdown.

leg_assignment.banc_primary_rule: nerve exactly '<side>_ventral_prothoracic_nerve' -> T1, '<side>_mesothoracic_leg_nerve' -> T2, '<side>_metathoracic_leg_nerve' -> T3, side in {left, right} from the nerve name; any other value (including multi-nerve strings and missing) is excluded and listed
leg_assignment.banc_side_cross_check: the side column is compared with the nerve side; disagreements are reported, not used
leg_assignment.banc_sensitivity_t1: count of SNpp45 rows whose nerve is a single '<side>_..._prothoracic_..._nerve' or '<side>_prosternal_nerve' name (no comma); reported only

measures.size_banc: l2_cable_length_um per neuron; median and sum per leg; volume_nm3 median reported
measures.size_malecns: total raw output synapses per neuron (sum of all CSR synapse counts of the neuron's row); median and sum per leg
measures.comparisons: per segment: right - left count difference; right/left ratios of median and summed size, within each dataset only
reported_only: BANC proofread flag of every included T1 row
T2/T3 right/left values in both datasets

integrity.I1_sources: BANC file sha equals 86ccf5df... and the provenance raw_sha256; Step A result sha equals e652a0c2...
integrity.I2_typing: BANC has >= 1 SNpp45 row in each of the six legs under the primary rule
integrity.I3_exclusions_bounded: excluded BANC SNpp45 rows <= 20 % of all BANC SNpp45 rows
integrity.I4_malecns_reproduction: MaleCNS sets from the annotations and cache give per-leg counts T1 left 7, T1 right 5, T2 left 12, T2 right 11, T3 left 8, T3 right 9, equal to the Step A result
integrity.I5_size_fields: every included BANC T1 row has finite positive l2_cable_length_um

Q_COUNT.d: n(BANC T1 right) - n(BANC T1 left)

Q_SIZE.r: median cable(BANC T1 right) / median cable(BANC T1 left)

Q_RF.RF_DEFICIT_NOT_REPLICATED: Q_COUNT in {COUNT_SYMMETRIC, COUNT_REVERSED} and Q_SIZE in {SIZE_SYMMETRIC, SIZE_REVERSED}

consequence_declared_in_advance: No weights, thresholds or mappings change from any outcome. REPLICATED: joint_RFCoxa stays BLOCKED_BY_INPUT, documented as a likely property of the fly (or a bias shared by both reconstructions). NOT_REPLICATED: deficit specific to MaleCNS (individual variation or under-tracing, not separable); any input substitution would be a separately designed, labelled engineering question, only on the user's decision. PARTIAL: recorded as is. In every case COXA_COORDINATE_STATUS.md gets one evidence line, no status change; coverage stays 20/42 admitted, +2 conditional.
interpretation_limits: Two animals only (male MaleCNS, female BANC); replication or non-replication, not population anatomy.
Size proxies differ by dataset (BANC cable length, MaleCNS output synapses); compared only as within-dataset right/left ratios.
SNpp45 neurons BANC failed to type are invisible; the sensitivity count bounds only the nerve-rule part.
Structural only; no simulation and no functional claim.
